note: Set B is preferred because it accurately extracts specific fastener details (wood lag screw, plate hole diameter) and dimensions (5'-2 1/2" spacing) that Set A misses. Set A contains significant binding errors, such as conflating the W10 structural beam with the steel decking specification and attributing a deck module dimension (1'-4 3/4") to the Railing Attachment detail (C1) instead of the Deck Module detail (A1). Both sets share a minor OCR error on the nail specification ("8 8D" vs "8D"), but Set B has fewer substantive inaccuracies.
